actions.item: 3D six-face Arrow Cube generator hostile saved-progress guard
actions.before: Nonfinite saved level and hostile coercion could select unwanted stage or crash cube generator
actions.change: Changed Number conversion to fail safe for untrusted values and clamp finite levels
actions.after: 3D generator no longer crashes on hostile level object; ten invalid level regression cases added

actions.item: 2D Arrow Escape saved-progress coercion fault isolation
actions.before: Object with throwing valueOf could crash stage generator despite numeric range guard

actions.after: 2D generator tolerates hostile imported level; regression added to existing solvability tests
